proof_summary: Above the respective thresholds, positivity supplies primes with \(p=n-q\) for even \(n\) and \(p=n-2q\) for odd \(n\), giving the desired decompositions directly; explicit finite witness checks cover all smaller admissible integers. For any bound \(A\), applying the even case to \(N=2A+8014\) yields \(2q<N\) and primes \(N-q-6\) and \(N-q\), so the former exceeds \(A\) and the two differ by 6, proving that such prime pairs are unbounded and hence infinite.
